Product catalog summary
Overview
Lake Shore's Hall Effect Measurement Systems (HMS) are designed for characterizing the physical properties of semiconductors and electronic materials. These systems are available in configurations with electromagnets up to 2 T and superconducting magnets up to 9 T, suitable for research, development, and quality control.
System Features
- Multiple magnet configurations: 4-, 7-, and 10-inch electromagnets and a 9 T superconducting magnet.
- Forward-swinging sample holder for easy access.
- Temperature range from 15 K to 800 K.
- Integrated software for sample definition and measurement profiles.
- Optional QMSA® software for advanced analysis.
Fields of Study
Applications include strained semiconductors, organic LEDs, solid state physics, semiconductor characterization, high-temperature superconductivity, and more.
Materials and Measurements
Capable of characterizing III-V semiconductors, dilute magnetic semiconductors, and high-temperature superconductors. Measurements include Hall voltage, resistance, magnetoresistance, Hall coefficient, carrier concentration, and mobility.
System Application Software
Windows-based software for data acquisition and analysis, supporting sample definition, measurement profiles, and real-time feedback.
QMSA® Analysis Software
Offers advanced multi-carrier analysis, providing parameters like conductivity spectra, carrier density, and mobility.
System Selection Guide
Consider resistance range, magnet configuration, and temperature range. The 7700A and 9700A series are versatile, while the 9709A model suits low mobility samples.
Specifications
Models like 76XX, 77XXA, and 9709A offer varying capabilities, measuring resistance from 0.04 mW to 200 GW and temperatures from 2 K to 800 K. They can handle up to 4 samples with a size limit of 152 mm².
Measurement Capabilities
Designed for Hall effect, magnetoresistance, and other electronic properties, suitable for classical and advanced measurements.
Applications
Used for measuring intrinsic conduction, temperature coefficients, Hall effect in metals, and magnetotransport in magnetic materials.
Advanced Features
Includes QMSA software for mobility spectrum analysis and supports high-temperature ovens and closed cycle refrigerators.
System Components
Includes sample holder modules, gaussmeters, current sources, and digital voltmeters. Requires specific cooling and power supplies.
Components and Accessories
Key components include the Model 750TC temperature controller and various sample holders. Vacuum systems like the Model TPS-FRG Compact Turbo Pumping System are highlighted.
Measurement Options
AC Current Hall Effect Measurement for high conductivity materials and contact blasting for low-resistance ohmic contacts.
Site Requirements
Requires specific power, water, and environmental conditions, including standard outlets and a dust-free environment.
Application Notes
Includes studies on low mobility carrier extraction, anomalous Hall effect magnetometry, and electronic transport characterization.
Ordering Information
Details on ordering different system models and options, including sample holder modules and software.
Company Information
Lake Shore Cryotronics, Inc., specializes in measurement solutions for cryogenic temperatures and magnetic fields.
